run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the pivot index where all left elements are smaller and all right elements are greater
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple array inputs to verify correct pivot index detection
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold algorithm that uses leftMax and rightMin arrays to find a partition element
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to eliminate the leftMax array and use a single pass approach instead
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like empty arrays, single elements, or fully sorted input
